title: Jalte Hue Khaime hai
body:
Jalte Hue Khaime hai
(Hai Dukhtare shere khuda, jo karbala mei hai berida) x2
<<MINI>>
(Jalte huwe khaime hain, naa bhaai naa rida hai) x2
(Ummat se milaa) x2 kaisa ye zainab ko silaa hai
(Jalte huwe khaime hain, naa bhaai naa rida hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Aale Abaa ke sar hai charhe nouke sinaa par, laashe pare hai harsu jo sab reg-e-tapaa par, (pehnaati unhe) x2
ban mei kafan khaake shafaa hai
<<MINI>>
(Jalte huwe khaime hain, naa bhaai naa rida hai) x2
Ummat se milaa, kaisa ye zainab ko silaa hai
(Jalte huwe khaime hain, naa bhaai naa rida hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Aabid ko laa rahi hai woh kaandho pe uthaa kar, aur shimr ko kehti hai zaraa khoufe khuda kar, (koi naa raha) x2 ik yehi bimaar bacha hai
<<MINI>>
(Jalte huwe khaime hain, naa bhaai naa rida hai) x2
Ummat se milaa, kaisa ye zainab ko silaa hai
(Jalte huwe khaime hain, naa bhaai naa rida hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Karte hai sab farishte shabbir ka matam, karti hai huro walma beshir ka matam, (matam shahe be) x2 kas ka sar-e-arsh bapaa hai
<<MINI>>
(Jalte huwe khaime hain, naa bhaai naa rida hai) x2
Ummat se milaa, kaisa ye zainab ko silaa hai
(Jalte huwe khaime hain, naa bhaai naa rida hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Is baat ki ai shaam-e-gharibaan hai gawaah tu, saare nahi ye saanie zehra ke hai aansu, (""Khursheed"" nahi) x2 aaj to khud rota khuda hai
<<MINI>>
(Jalte huwe khaime hain, naa bhaai naa rida hai) x2
Ummat se milaa, kaisa ye zainab ko silaa hai
(Jalte huwe khaime hain, naa bhaai naa rida hai) x4
